changes: Fixed response header fragments and decimal Content-Length replace snprintf, preserving exact wire bytes/status behavior.
Monotonic time cached per poll/readiness/flush batch; refreshed after blocking epoll_wait and after Goose/commit work before sends.
clock_test: clock_check.c with --wrap=clock_gettime,--wrap=epoll_wait; verifies idle retention and freshness after simulated wait/delayed commit without long sleeps.
fixture_correction: Initial clock fixture omitted EPOLL_CTL_ADD for its synthetic socket; flush correctly rejected MOD with ENOENT and closed it. Corrected fixture registers the real socket. Production clock implementation was unchanged. Initial failure retained in clock-initial-fixture-failure.log.
limitations: Transport correctness only; application/API validation and measured speedup are evaluated separately.
No production PGO stop hook or response-storage lifetime change.
